description: Android service class for managing Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) GATT connections, handling connection states, service discovery, characteristic read/write, and data broadcasting.

classes.name: BluetoothLeService
classes.description: Android service for managing BLE GATT connections, handling connection lifecycle, service discovery, characteristic communication, and broadcasting updates.

classes.name: LocalBinder
classes.description: Binder class for clients to interact with BluetoothLeService.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a BLE device given its address, reusing existing GATT connection if possible.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current BLE device.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases BLE resources by closing the GATT connection.

methods.name: readCharacteristic
methods.description: Requests a read of a specified GATT characteristic.

methods.name: setCharacteristicNotification
methods.description: Enables or disables notifications for a specified characteristic.

methods.name: getSupportedGattServices
methods.description: Returns a list of supported GATT services on the connected device.

methods.name: broadcastUpdate
methods.description: Sends broadcast intents for various GATT events, optionally including characteristic data.
